## Core Value Proposition
- **140 Deduplicated, IP-Safe Ready Metal Molds (`FS-001` to `FS-150`)**: Cleaned from 148 production rows (duplicate #147 merged into FS-135; out-of-stock #65 archived; multi-material molds FS-114/115/132, FS-105/106, FS-107/112, FS-030/031, FS-094/095 unified with tier selectors).
- **$0.00 Tooling / Mold Fee**: All 140 models use mature production molds ready for immediate blank dispatch (MOQ 50 pcs) or custom Fiber Laser / UV Color Logo branding (MOQ 100 pcs).
- **US CPSC 16 CFR 1262 & EU RoHS/REACH Compliant**: Captive blind counterbores, two-part structural epoxy (>22 MPa), and thread-locked M2/M2.5 fasteners prevent magnet detachment.
